behavior_anomalies.why: The run starts with zero ventilators and repeatedly attempts to deliver them, but never shows failed delivery, zero-inventory consequences, or patients remaining without ventilation. The log instead only continues recording patient arrivals, so the expected consequence of the zero resource is absent.

The logged patient count exceeds the hospital's stated 40-bed capacity, but the run shows no diversion, transfer, overflow capacity, or other consequence of bed capacity being exceeded. Patient arrivals then continue to 382.

rule deliver-ordered-ventilators-v1 can never be offered: its actor selector {'categories': ['hospital'], 'components': ['hospital_capacity']} matches only entities that cannot act; the actor must be an entity in category 'actor' (put the object it uses in participants).

action admit-flu-patients-v1 refuses up front with check 'the hospital has enough available beds' on actor.components.hospital_capacity.available_beds, a stock the actor's own activity consumes. Fix with three changes: (1) the action only STARTS the activity (sets a status such as 'driving'), with no check on that stock and no progress or consumption effects; (2) add a process that, every tick while the status is active and the stock is above zero, makes one tick of progress and consumes the stock; (3) add a process that switches the status to a stopped/failed value when the stock is at or below zero, so the actor discovers it by observation.
